+"""Scheduled maintenance windows: date ranges during which an item cannot be rented."""
+
+from app.errors import ConflictError
+from app.models import MaintenanceWindow, MaintenanceWindowCreate, ReservationStatus
+from app.services.availability import overlaps, validate_range
+from app.services.catalog import get_item
+from app.storage import Store
+
+
+def list_maintenance(store: Store, item_id: int) -> list[MaintenanceWindow]:
+    """Windows of an item ordered by start date, then id."""
+    get_item(store, item_id)
+    return store.maintenance.for_item(item_id)
+
+
+def create_maintenance(
+    store: Store, item_id: int, data: MaintenanceWindowCreate
+) -> MaintenanceWindow:
+    """Schedule ``[start, end)`` as maintenance for an item.
+
+    The range must be non-empty and must not overlap an active reservation of the item.
+    Cancelled and returned reservations do not block it. Windows may overlap each other.
+    """
+    validate_range(data.start, data.end)
+    get_item(store, item_id)
+
+    blocking = [
+        reservation
+        for reservation in store.reservations.for_item(item_id)
+        if reservation.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
+        and overlaps(reservation.start, reservation.end, data.start, data.end)
+    ]
+    if blocking:
+        ids = ", ".join(str(r.id) for r in blocking)
+        raise ConflictError(f"Item {item_id} has active reservations in this period ({ids})")
+
+    window = MaintenanceWindow(
+        id=store.maintenance.allocate_id(),
+        item_id=item_id,
+        start=data.start,
+        end=data.end,
+    )
+    return store.maintenance.insert(window)

+    """Reserve every item of ``data`` or none of them.

+    """
+    if not data.items or len(set(data.items)) != len(data.items):

+    if data.start < today:
+        raise InvalidRequestError("Reservations cannot start in the past")
+    if (data.end - data.start).days > MAX_RENTAL_DAYS:
+        raise InvalidRequestError(f"Reservations are limited to {MAX_RENTAL_DAYS} days")
+
+    customer = get_customer(store, data.customer_id)
+
+    coupon_code: str | None = None
+    if data.coupon_code:

+        coupon_code = coupon.code
+
+    items = [get_item(store, item_id) for item_id in data.items]
+

+        end=data.end,

+    )
+    store.bookings.insert(record)
+    for item in items:
+        store.reservations.insert(
+            Reservation(
+                id=store.reservations.allocate_id(),
+                item_id=item.id,
+                customer_id=customer.id,
+                start=data.start,
+                end=data.end,
+                coupon_code=coupon_code,
+                created_on=today,

+            )
+        )

+
+def cancel_booking(store: Store, booking_id: int) -> Booking:
+    """Cancel every active reservation of the booking; returned ones are left alone."""
+    record = get_booking_record(store, booking_id)
+    active = [

+        if r.status is ReservationStatus.ACTIVE
+    ]

+        )
+    return to_booking(store, record)

+"""Commercial rule parameters: the single source of truth for pricing and booking rules.
+
+Services read ``PRICING`` at call time through this module (``settings.PRICING``), so
+rebinding the module attribute to a modified copy changes behaviour without a restart.
+Rates are fractions (``Decimal("0.20")`` means 20%).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from app.models import CustomerTier
+
+
+def _default_tier_discounts() -> dict[CustomerTier, Decimal]:
+    return {
+        CustomerTier.REGULAR: Decimal("0"),
+        CustomerTier.SILVER: Decimal("0.05"),
+        CustomerTier.GOLD: Decimal("0.15"),
+    }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PricingSettings:
+    tax_rate: Decimal = Decimal("0.20")
+    tier_discounts: dict[CustomerTier, Decimal] = field(default_factory=_default_tier_discounts)
+    max_total_discount: Decimal = Decimal("0.30")
+    free_day_every: int = 7
+    late_fee_multiplier: Decimal = Decimal("1.5")
+    max_rental_days: int = 90
+
+
+PRICING = PricingSettings()

@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+import dataclasses
+from datetime import date
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+import app.settings
+from app.clock import FixedClock
+from app.models import CustomerTier
+from app.settings import PRICING, PricingSettings
+
+
+def _replace_pricing(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, **changes: object) -> None:
+    """Rebind app.settings.PRICING to a modified copy; monkeypatch restores it afterwards."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        app.settings, "PRICING", dataclasses.replace(app.settings.PRICING, **changes)
+    )
+
+
+def _payload(item_id: int, customer_id: int, start: str, end: str) -> dict:
+    return {"item_id": item_id, "customer_id": customer_id, "start": start, "end": end}
+
+
+# --- the dataclass itself --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_defaults_match_ticket_table() -> None:
+    settings = PricingSettings()
+    assert settings == PRICING
+    assert settings.tax_rate == Decimal("0.20")
+    assert settings.tier_discounts == {
+        CustomerTier.REGULAR: Decimal("0"),
+        CustomerTier.SILVER: Decimal("0.05"),
+        CustomerTier.GOLD: Decimal("0.15"),
+    }
+    assert settings.max_total_discount == Decimal("0.30")
+    assert settings.free_day_every == 7
+    assert settings.late_fee_multiplier == Decimal("1.5")
+    assert settings.max_rental_days == 90
+
+
+def test_pricing_settings_is_frozen() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
+        PRICING.tax_rate = Decimal("0.10")  # type: ignore[misc]
+
+
+# --- rebinding app.settings.PRICING changes behaviour without restart ------------------
+
+
+def test_tax_rate_change_alters_invoice_total(
+    client: TestClient, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    # reservation 4: circular saw, 3 days x 18.00 = 54.00, regular customer, no coupon
+    assert client.get("/reservations/4/invoice").json()["tax"] == "10.80"
+    _replace_pricing(monkeypatch, tax_rate=Decimal("0.10"))
+    body = client.get("/reservations/4/invoice").json()
+    assert body["tax"] == "5.40"
+    assert body["total"] == "59.40"
+
+
+def test_tier_discount_change_alters_discount(
+    client: TestClient, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    # reservation 5: family tent, subtotal 175.00, gold customer
+    assert client.get("/reservations/5/invoice").json()["discount"] == "26.25"
+    tiers = dict(PRICING.tier_discounts)
+    tiers[CustomerTier.GOLD] = Decimal("0.25")
+    _replace_pricing(monkeypatch, tier_discounts=tiers)
+    assert client.get("/reservations/5/invoice").json()["discount"] == "43.75"
+
+
+def test_free_day_rule_change_alters_billable_days(
+    client: TestClient, reserve, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    # 14-day sleeping bag rental (8.00/day): default gives 2 free days
+    created = reserve(7, 1, "2025-06-05", "2025-06-19")
+    line = client.get(f"/reservations/{created['id']}/invoice").json()["lines"][0]
+    assert line["quantity"] == 12
+
+    _replace_pricing(monkeypatch, free_day_every=14)
+    line = client.get(f"/reservations/{created['id']}/invoice").json()["lines"][0]
+    assert line["description"] == "Sleeping Bag rental (14 days, 1 free)"
+    assert line["quantity"] == 13
+    assert line["amount"] == "104.00"
+
+
+def test_late_fee_multiplier_change_alters_return_receipt(
+    client: TestClient, clock: FixedClock, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    # reservation 4 (circular saw, 18.00/day) ends 2025-06-04; returning on 2025-06-09 is
+    # 6 late days
+    clock.set(date(2025, 6, 9))
+    _replace_pricing(monkeypatch, late_fee_multiplier=Decimal("2.0"))
+    receipt = client.post("/reservations/4/return").json()
+    assert receipt["late_days"] == 6
+    assert receipt["late_fee"] == "216.00"  # 6 x 18.00 x 2.0
+
+
+def test_late_fee_multiplier_change_alters_invoice(
+    client: TestClient, clock: FixedClock, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    clock.set(date(2025, 6, 9))
+    assert client.post("/reservations/4/return").status_code == 200
+    late = client.get("/reservations/4/invoice").json()["lines"][1]
+    # unit_price is the unrounded late rate (18.00 x multiplier), as it is today
+    assert late["unit_price"] == "27.000"
+    assert late["amount"] == "162.00"
+
+    _replace_pricing(monkeypatch, late_fee_multiplier=Decimal("2.0"))
+    late = client.get("/reservations/4/invoice").json()["lines"][1]
+    assert late["unit_price"] == "36.000"
+    assert late["amount"] == "216.00"
+
+
+def test_max_rental_days_change_alters_reservation_limit(
+    client: TestClient, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    # 11 days: allowed by default, rejected once the limit is 10
+    payload = _payload(1, 1, "2025-06-05", "2025-06-16")
+    assert client.post("/reservations", json=payload).status_code == 201
+
+    _replace_pricing(monkeypatch, max_rental_days=10)
+    response = client.post("/reservations", json=_payload(1, 1, "2025-06-20", "2025-07-01"))
+    assert response.status_code == 422
+    assert response.json() == {
+        "detail": "Reservations are limited to 10 days",
+        "code": "invalid_request",
+    }
+    # exactly at the limit is still accepted
+    ok = client.post("/reservations", json=_payload(1, 1, "2025-06-20", "2025-06-30"))
+    assert ok.status_code == 201
+
+
+def test_monkeypatch_restores_default_settings(

+"""Commercial rule parameters: the single source of truth for pricing and booking rules.
+
+Services read ``PRICING`` at call time through this module (``settings.PRICING``), so
+rebinding the module attribute to a modified copy changes behaviour without a restart.
+Rates are fractions (``Decimal("0.20")`` means 20%).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from app.models import CustomerTier
+
+
+def _default_tier_discounts() -> dict[CustomerTier, Decimal]:
+    return {
+        CustomerTier.REGULAR: Decimal("0"),
+        CustomerTier.SILVER: Decimal("0.05"),
+        CustomerTier.GOLD: Decimal("0.15"),
+    }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PricingSettings:
+    tax_rate: Decimal = Decimal("0.20")
+    tier_discounts: dict[CustomerTier, Decimal] = field(default_factory=_default_tier_discounts)
+    max_total_discount: Decimal = Decimal("0.30")
+    free_day_every: int = 7
+    late_fee_multiplier: Decimal = Decimal("1.5")
+    max_rental_days: int = 90
+
+
+PRICING = PricingSettings()

+"""Commercial rule parameters: the single source of truth for pricing and booking rules.
+
+Services read ``PRICING`` at call time through this module (``settings.PRICING``), so
+rebinding the module attribute to a modified copy changes behaviour without a restart.
+Rates are fractions (``Decimal("0.20")`` means 20%).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from app.models import CustomerTier
+
+
+def _default_tier_discounts() -> dict[CustomerTier, Decimal]:
+    return {
+        CustomerTier.REGULAR: Decimal("0"),
+        CustomerTier.SILVER: Decimal("0.05"),
+        CustomerTier.GOLD: Decimal("0.15"),
+    }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PricingSettings:
+    tax_rate: Decimal = Decimal("0.20")
+    tier_discounts: dict[CustomerTier, Decimal] = field(default_factory=_default_tier_discounts)
+    max_total_discount: Decimal = Decimal("0.30")
+    free_day_every: int = 7
+    late_fee_multiplier: Decimal = Decimal("1.5")
+    max_rental_days: int = 90
+
+
+PRICING = PricingSettings()
